articles.title: Eutelsat’s ground infrastructure sale falls through
articles.summary:
Eutelsat said a planned sale of its passive ground infrastructure to a private equity firm announced in August 2024 will not proceed, eliminating roughly $658 million in expected proceeds.

articles.title: NASA Analysis Shows La Niña Limited Sea Level Rise in 2025
articles.summary: A mild La Niña caused greater rainfall over the Amazon basin, which offset rising sea levels due to record warming of Earth’s oceans.
